address_comment_regular: Native encoded animation-key resolver. A candidate is valid only when its map entry's selector virtual returns a sequence. Order: exact key; weapon-prefix compatibility; fast-move group to normal-move group; on the outer pass only, strip movement prefix; finally replace nonzero group with Idle (0). Returns 0 on failure.

ctree_comments.comment: Exact candidate validation is stronger than map presence: invoke AnimSequenceSingle/Multiple vtable +0x10 with selector -1 and accept only a non-null sequence.
Weapon prefix 4 (Staff): unless movement prefix is Swimming (2), try TwoHand (3) before the shared OneHand/unprefixed fallbacks.
Weapon prefixes TwoHand (3), Staff (4), and Bow (5) try OneHand (2). Other nonzero weapon prefixes skip directly to unprefixed.
Final same-movement/group weapon fallback clears bits 8..11 to the unprefixed key.
FastForward (7) recursively resolves Forward (3), preserving movement and weapon prefix bits.
FastBackward (8) recursively resolves Backward (4), preserving movement and weapon prefix bits.
FastLeft (9) recursively resolves Left (5), preserving movement and weapon prefix bits.
FastRight (10) recursively resolves Right (6), preserving movement and weapon prefix bits.
fallbackPass is a recursion guard: nested fast/movement fallback may use exact/weapon/fast resolution but cannot continue into another movement-strip or group-to-Idle pass.
Outer pass only: clear movement-prefix bits 12..15 and recursively resolve the same weapon/group with fallbackPass=1.
Last outer fallback: if group is nonzero, replace only the low group byte with Idle (0), preserve movement/weapon prefixes, and restart the resolver.
